thread:
Sam: Heads-up — customers hitting 429s after the version-negotiation change. Console shows most traffic as v2 but some sessions are still routed to v1. Quota numbers look inconsistent.
Ayla: Can you paste a failing request header and a small snippet of the console view?
Sam: Example request (from customer report):\n```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'\n# Note: no Accept-Version header and X-Client-Version: 1.2.3
```
Sam: Console screenshot pasted in thread (emailing to infra for redaction). The console indicates "Preferred version: v2" but the request that failed pinged v1 endpoints and consumed v1 quota.
Jorge: Sounds like our default fallthrough rules are creating mixed routing for unversioned clients. We rolled the change last week that prefers v2 but left affinity heuristics in place — some long-lived sessions keep v1 pinned.
Ayla: Telemetry: unversioned requests over last 24h = 18,243. Breakdown: 92% -> v2, 8% -> v1. Most of the v1 routed ones are from SDK versions <1.3.
Morgan: Impact: customers expecting legacy behavior on Dedicated/reserved capacity are surprised when quotas/debiting happens against the wrong bucket. We need a predictable grace policy + console signal.
Jorge: Proposal (short):
1) Runtime: keep v2 as default for new sessions, but honor existing affinity for sessions with existing KV cookie for 14 days.
2) Console: surface an "Unversioned traffic" banner and per-customer split metric.
3) Quotas: treat unversioned as the customer's current pin for Dedicated; for Hosted, bill against the runtime-chosen version but expose a 7-day grace reconciliation window.
Sam: Edge case: on-prem/private deployments where ops pinned a specific model version — we must not silently flip them. How do we detect and exempt?
Ayla: We have deployment_type metadata ("dedicated", "private", "hosted"). Suggest: if deployment_type != "hosted" then respect explicit pin mappings, ignore fallthrough.
Jorge: Agree. Implementation plan: add a short-circuit in router: if customer_config.pinned_version exists -> route there. Otherwise follow the v2-preference + affinity fallback. I'll sketch the config flags.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: starting canary deploy of "routing-unversioned-fix" to 5% of traffic at 2332110200 :rocket:
Morgan: Ops/Console tasks: (A) add top-ribbon explaining the change + link to migration docs (I'll own), (B) new telemetry metric `unversioned_route_breakdown` (Ayla can own), (C) update billing docs for grace reconciliation (Morgan).
Ayla: I'll add the metric and a Grafana panel under "Routing -> Versioning". Suggest alert if unversioned->v1 > 5% for a tenant.
Jorge: I'll add runtime config, tests, and the canary. Also adding an audit log entry when we route unversioned traffic to a different version than the customer's last-pinned one.
Sam: Filing follow-ups: INF-2123 (runtime short-circuit), PLAT-834 (console ribbon + docs), TELE-401 (new metric). Assigning owners in the tickets.
Morgan: Quick UX note: make banner message actionable — button "Pin my apps to v1" and a link to update SDKs. Avoid scary language.
Sam: Thanks all. Ping me if you need the failing customer's logs; I've redacted PII and posted to the secure channel.
Jorge: Will do. Next steps — ship canary, monitor `unversioned_route_breakdown`, and reconvene in 24h. :thumbsup:
